Police Chief Suggests Harsher Penalties for Illicit Tobacco Smokers

A police chief has suggested that smokers should face tougher penalties for engaging with illicit tobacco. This suggestion comes amid discussions about tobacco taxation and the illicit trade. One report noted that an ex-police officer proposed cutting tobacco tax, implying a different approach to addressing the issue. The coverage does not specify the jurisdiction or the exact nature of the proposed penalties.
